lines.text: Many learners say: What you want to eat?
Better: What do you want to eat?

data.right: What do you want to eat?

native.tip: 한국어는 “뭐 먹고 싶어?”처럼 어순을 바꾸지 않고 억양만 올려서, 영어도 do 없이 말하기 쉬워요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “What do you want to eat?”

en.tip: In a question, put do before you. Say “What do you want to eat?”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “What you want to eat?” In a question, put do before you. Right: “What do you want to eat?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
